title: This wasn't directional flow. It was a mint.

intent.expected: A submitted Call should become verifiable through the normal fill-confirmation path and its displayed stake should reflect true collateral economics.

venueReality.summary: The chain confirmed success quickly, the indexer-backed verification path returned unavailable, and the captured fill used DreamDEX's MINT_A_PAIR path whose quote fields are easy to misread as total trade cost.

reconciliation.finalState: Treat chain success as authoritative, decode MINT_A_PAIR economics, then retry indexed reads rather than resubmitting a compensating transaction.

limitations: The public source redacts the middle of the transaction hash.
This fixture proves an observed incident class, not incident prevalence.
